about: What the app does with each document tool call: the app's DocumentToolExecutor (Dart test test/tool_contract_test.dart) and its Python twin daylex_server/docsim.py (tests/test_tool_contract.py) must both give these results. `after` is the document after the call, without ids and dates; it is absent when the call leaves the document as it was. The documents are as a current app sends them: each theme names its base (rfc/055). A new document starts from the legal base, the test's studio style.
